text: Humanitarian's AI YouTube playlists including Claude basics and extending Claude. This gave me hands-on experience with the existing content workflow while helping move completed material into the published library. It explains Kafka's durable log, partitions, brokers, consumer groups, offsets, rebalancing, and replication.
